title: Leaf computes a constant junta restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ map the sign cube $\{\pm1\}^n$ to the two signs, let $P$ be a set of coordinates, and fix a sign assignment $z$ on $P$. If the restriction of $f$ obtained by fixing the coordinates in $P$ according to $z$ is constantly equal to a sign $v$, then the decision tree consisting of a single leaf labelled $v$, with available coordinates those outside $P$, computes $f$ on every binary input whose sign encoding agrees with $z$ on $P$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function from the sign cube to the two signs
The restriction of the function under $z$ is constantly $v$
